newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: De Beers, union fail to reach wage deal.
newsitem.headline: De Beers, union fail to reach wage deal.

text.p: Diamond giant De Beers Consolidated Ltd said it and the National Union of Mineworkers (NUM) had failed to reach agreement on annual wage increases at talks on Thursday.
De Beers is offering a nine percent increase on employees' monthly pensionable rates of pay, excluding a one percent service increment which employees will receive.

"The NUM expressed its dissatisfaction with the proposal and failed to amend its demand for 10 percent (excluding the service increment) and for increases equivalent to the Consumer Price Index plus one percent in the second and third years of an extended agreement," De Beers said in a statement.

De Beers said it had offered an extended agreement for the second and third year of an eight percent increase to individuals' pensionable rates and an allocation of an additional one percent of the basic wage bill for distribution to individuals based on their performance.
De Beers said a date for the next meeting on wage negotiations had yet to be determined.
